images.name: 余烬·崩垒
images.design: Heavy crimson architectural battering mace. A stout solid bevelled rectangular cuboid head, squat roughly as tall as wide, broad unbroken red planes. On each side face one large short square-based pyramidal tooth, plus a low stepped square crown at the top. The four radial wedge teeth are thick, blunt-rooted and pointed, not thin long needles. Two recessed horizontal steps break up the central block like fortress courses. Head firmly seated on a short square collar and thick polygonal shaft. Compact trapezoidal hand stop above single-palm grip, clipped square pommel. Scarlet body, vermilion/coral glowing bevels, tiny square ember particles near impact teeth. Compact brutal silhouette, no hollow ring, no decorative wings.

images.name: 流萤·旋棘
images.design: Jade-green spiral-thorn flanged mace. Ovoid compact head formed by THREE substantial broad twisted triangular flanges wrapping around a short solid central hexagonal core, separated by three long clean negative-space slots. Each flange curves gently in a partial helix and ends in a stout outward thorn near its upper shoulder; short sharp cap at top. Flanges are thick sculptural slabs, not leaves or wire, no vines or botanical textures. Spiral only in the upper mace head, lower shaft straight sturdy and easy to grip. Swept crescent small hand stop, streamlined spindle pommel. Jade faces with mint and turquoise luminous ridges, tiny curved crescent particles following the head's spiral. Elegant but visibly weighty striking head, not a spear or flower.

images.name: 寒汐·镇环
images.design: Ice-blue annular spiked mace. A VERY THICK compact vertical octagonal torus head with a single small real octagonal through-opening in its center. Ring wall extremely substantial, chunky octagonal hammer-like volume with deep front-to-back extrusion, outer diameter about twice central opening diameter. Four short broad pyramidal impact studs project radially from top, left, right and two diagonal shoulders as appropriate to perspective. Vertical straight shaft joins underside via a wide solid fork collar that merges with ring, no detached floating objects. Octagonal hand stop and flattened disc pommel. Cobalt blue faces with cyan edges, small hollow cyan polygon particle rings next to head. Clearly a compact brutal mace, not a large magical staff or thin hoop, not an axe.

images.name: 梦隙·错棱
images.design: Violet offset-block spiked mace. Compact asymmetric head assembled from TWO chunky overlapping bevelled cubes, upper cube shifted slightly left and rotated 35 degrees relative to lower cube, creating stepped interlocking silhouette and diagonal seam. Cubes are physically joined around central short shaft; no floating parts. Four stout triangular wedge studs project from exposed outer cube corners, distinct short striking teeth, no long blade. Top is an oblique flattened diamond cap. Lower cube flares into an angular offset shoulder above a sturdy straight octagonal shaft. Small asymmetric split-chevron hand stop well above a short comfortable grip, faceted triangular pommel. Deep violet solid planes with blue-violet and lavender glowing ridges; several tiny triangular shards near the head. Strong compact geometric glitch-like mass, not a sword, no spherical head, no ring.
